text:
anya: Quick heads-up: onboarding smoke test with sampleapp v1.4 failed on routes verification. SDK.listRoutes only returns compact summaries; sampleapp expects the full REST response.

matt: which fields are missing exactly?

anya: REST GET /v1/routes returns visibility:string, policy:{...}, last_deploy. SDK returns {id, name, is_public}. sampleapp checks route.visibility === 'public' and then reads policy.rules -> crash.

alex: we intentionally trimmed route metadata to reduce network payloads for hot paths. But parity gap is breaking onboarding templates which assume REST shape.

sara: also param-name drift: REST uses "visibility" (string), SDK uses "is_public" (boolean). Loose equality checks fail.

anya: repro snippet I ran locally:
```
// SDK
const routes = await client.listRoutes({project: 'demo'});
// routes[0] -> { id: 'r_tmp', name: 'inbound', is_public: true }
// sampleapp does: if (route.visibility !== 'public') return error
```
vs REST:
```
GET /v1/routes?project=demo
[ { id: 'r_tmp', visibility: 'public', policy: { rules: [...] }, last_deploy: '2026-03-01T12:00:00Z' } ]
```

tina: bonus problem: onboarding webhook saw duplicate provisioning. REST returned 429 with Retry-After but SDK's retry layer ignored the header and retried earlier, causing two provisioning calls. infra alert fired.

devex-bot: Created tickets: SDK-600 (includeDetails param for listRoutes), SDK-601 (retry-after header honor + config), DOCS-300 (sampleapp validation relaxation).

matt: propose three-step fix: 1) add opt-in includeDetails=true to listRoutes so SDK can return REST-shaped objects (no breaking change); 2) add compatibility shim mapping is_public <-> visibility and include both keys for a deprecation window; 3) update SDK retryer to respect Retry-After and expose preferServerRetryHeader config.

alex: I can cut a patch branch and publish a beta for includeDetails today. Retry change needs a minor bump and tests; aim tomorrow. Shim mapping included in the minor.

sara: docs change: relax sampleapp validation to accept either shape for 2 weeks, add unit tests covering both returned object shapes. We'll revert once SDK emits full objects by default.

anya: I'll open the sampleapp PR and add a TODO pointing to SDK-600/601. Also drafting a changelog blurb explaining the temporary shim and migration steps.

matt: please call out the exact recommended field to migrate to (visibility string) and an example mapping snippet in the changelog. Customers expect field stability. :eyes: 

devex-bot: infra alert resolved? Follow-ups scheduled in tickets above.

anya: thanks — once beta is published I'll rerun smoke tests and report back.
